verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party export feature, open-format download, or data portability tooling from Shortwave. The only related point is a community remark that users can return to Gmail by deleting their Shortwave account. That is a host-platform capability, since the mail stays in Gmail, not Shortwave's own export of its data such as comments, snippets, AI memory, or filters.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
